integrity: The full arXiv preprint was inspected at the definition of LS*, the definition of DB_p^+, both directions of Theorem 5.3, and Proposition A.1. The fixed-arity claim is obtained by tracking the exact number of orders through those explicit computable constructions: r input orders require r-1 separator instances, while m separator instances produce exactly m+1 input orders for DB_p^+.
scientific_limitations: The classification is for the strengthened point-removal problem DB_p^+, not the weaker DB_p. It uses ordinary Weihrauch reducibility and does not assert that the finite powers of XC_1 are pairwise distinct. No strong-Weihrauch or optimal dimension-separation claim is made.
title: Point-removal dimension has exact finite convex-choice degree
